title: Umami Rich Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A low-glycemic-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring chilli bean paste and mirepoix-base, perfect for a date-night dinner
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together chilli bean paste, olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the chilli bean paste mixture
Thread the beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
In a large skillet, saute the onion, carrot, and celery over medium heat until the vegetables are tender
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Place the skewers on the preheated hot stone plate and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally
Serve the beef skewers on top of the sauteed mirepoix-base and garnish with fresh parsley
